common.title: Adoption Delivers
common.line: Public-sector AI adoption produces visible, measurable benefit – waiting lists that fall, decisions that arrive in days rather than months, teaching that demonstrably works – and it is attributed to a European decision rather than to an American product.

common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

notable.title: Gigafactory site blockade
notable.line: Coordinated physical protests and grid-connection blockades halt construction prep at one or more of the five reserved EU gigafactory sites, fusing power-price anger with anti-AI sentiment.

notable.title: Grid site blockade
notable.line: Coordinated municipal power-price protests escalate into blockades of reserved gigafactory grid connections, forcing a member state to suspend site permitting for the turn.
